Cinzel, by Natanael Gama, copied unmodified from Google Fonts on
2026-09-20 (the static weight 600 instance Google serves):

  https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Cinzel
  https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/cinzel

  cinzel-600-latin.woff2      the latin subset
  cinzel-600-latin-ext.woff2  the latin-ext subset, for names such as
                              Göktürk and Đại Việt

Licence: SIL Open Font License 1.1, in OFL.txt beside this file.

Consumers: the Roman capitals of an engraved chart. js/globe.js letters
the states on the map in it; site.css sets the brand, the polity names,
the year readout, the card page's title and its section headings in it;
js/app.js draws the era names on the timeline in it.
